# Network

`jaff.core.Network`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Astrochemical reaction network loaded from a file.

After construction the following public attributes are available:

## Constructor

`#!python Network(fname, config=None, strict=None, label=None, funcfile=None, duplicate_policy=None, expand_nuclei=None, radiation_props=None, dust_props=None, use_proxy_photoreaction=None, eos_props=None, use_jaff_toml=True)`

**Parameters**

**fname** : _str | Path_
: Path to the network file, or the name of a predefined network (a
    sub-directory of `NETWORKS_DIR` containing a
    single `.jet` file).  A predefined network name wins over a
    same-named path on disk.  Supported extensions: any text format
    auto-detected by `NetworkParser`, plus `.jaff` binary files.

**config** : _ConfigLayer or sequence of them, optional_
: Config layers stacked over the `jaff.toml` next to the network
    file: a TOML file path, a `dict` shaped like a `jaff.toml`
    (`{"network": {...}}`) or a `JaffTomlConfig`; see
    `load_network_config`.  The keyword
    arguments below override them when given (not `None`).

**strict** : _bool | None, optional_
: If `True`, treat conservation violations and validation problems
    as fatal errors (process exits).  Default (`network.strict`):
    `False` (warnings only).

**label** : _str | None, optional_
: Human-readable name for this network.  Defaults to the file stem.

**funcfile** : _bool | str | Path | None, optional_
: Path to a `.jfunc` auxiliary function file.  `True` (the
    default) scans the network's directory for `<network>.jfunc`;
    `False` skips auxiliary-function loading entirely.

**duplicate_policy** : _str | None, optional_
: How to resolve two rate coefficients sharing a reaction, mechanism,
    and temperature range: `"preserve-first"` (keep the first, drop
    later duplicates; the default), `"preserve-last"` (keep the last),
    or `"error"` (raise a `ParserError`).  Sets
    `network.reactions.duplicate_policy`; a reaction's own policy in
    the config still wins.

**expand_nuclei** : _bool | None, optional_
: When `True` (default), an `n_<element>_nuc` symbol (e.g.
    `n_H_nuc`, `n_He_nuc`) in rate expressions is expanded to the
    element-nucleus sum — `Σ atom-count · nden[i]` over all species
    bearing that element.  Set to `False` to keep it as a free symbol
    `n<element>_nuc` (e.g. `nh_nuc`).  (Plain `n_X` always resolves
    to species `X`; only `n_X_nuc` is affected by this flag.)

**radiation_props** : _RadiationConfig | dict | None, optional_
: Radiation field (`network.radiation`): enables the network's
    `Radiation` and photochemistry.  Its keys override those of
    a `[network.radiation]` table in the config.  Without either, no
    radiation field is built and photochemistry is disabled.

**dust_props** : _DustConfig | dict | None, optional_
: Dust (`network.dust`): enables the network's `Dust`.  Its
    keys override those of a `[network.dust]` table in the config.
    Without either, the dust module is disabled.

**use_proxy_photoreaction** : _bool | None, optional_
: When `True` (default), cross-sections for photo-reactions are looked up
    using the proxy photo-reaction string (via
    `normalized_proxy_reaction_str`) rather than the
    reaction's standard serialized form, so proxy species such as
    `CHx`/`OHx` resolve to the `CH`/`OH` entries.  A custom
    `.jfunc` rate still takes precedence over the cross-sections.
    Sets `network.reactions.photo.use_proxy_photoreaction`.

**eos_props** : _EosConfig | dict | None, optional_
: Equation of state (`network.thermodynamics.eos`) used by
    `eos`; it replaces a `[network.thermodynamics.eos]`
    table in the config whole.  Without either, an ideal gas with the
    default adiabatic index is used.

**use_jaff_toml** : _bool, optional_
: Stack the `jaff.toml` next to the network file, if any, under the
    `config` layers (default `True`).

**Raises**

_FileNotFoundError_
: If *fname* is neither an existing file nor a predefined network
    name, or a predefined network directory has no `.jet` file.

_ParserError_
: If a predefined network directory has more than one `.jet` file,
    or the config is invalid.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filename` | `Path` | Absolute path to the source network file. |
| `label` | `str` | Human-readable label for this network (defaults to the file stem). |
| `species` | `Species` | Ordered catalogue of the network's core (real) species. Special pseudo-species (`_PHOTON`, `_CR`, `_GRAIN`, ...) are excluded; they live only inside each reaction's `reactants`/`products` and carry the reaction's identity without entering the integrated state. |
| `reactions` | `Reactions` | Ordered catalogue of all reactions in the network. |
| `elements` | `Elements` | Unique elements derived from all species. |
| `reactant_matrix` | `np.ndarray` | Integer stoichiometry matrix, shape `(n_reactions, n_species)`. Entry `[i, j]` counts how many times species *j* appears as a reactant in reaction *i*. |
| `product_matrix` | `np.ndarray` | Integer stoichiometry matrix for products, same shape. |
| `thermodynamics` | `Thermodynamics` | Heating/cooling terms: `dEdt_chemical` (accumulated over all reactions) and `dEdt_extra` (from the `heatingcoolingrate` auxiliary function, if present), both in erg cm⁻³ s⁻¹. |
| `symbols` | `NetworkSymbols` | Canonical symbols, density expressions, introspection sets and symbol standardization for this network. |
| `radiation` | `Radiation | None` | Radiation field object; `None` when no radiation bands are specified. |
| `mass_dict` | `dict[str, ElementProps]` | Element mass dictionary used during species construction. |
| `spec` | `NetworkSpec` | The normalized construction parameters this network was built from. |
| `config` | `NetworkConfig` | The validated config: the `jaff.toml` next to the network, the `config` layers, then the keyword arguments. |

## Properties

| Property | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`filename`](filename.md) | Absolute path to the source network file (from `spec`). |
| [`label`](label.md) | Human-readable label for this network (from `spec`). |

## Methods

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`write_shielding_tables`](write_shielding_tables.md) | Write the data tables of the reactions' shielding models into *directory*. |
| [`to_jaff`](to_jaff.md) | Serialise this network to a binary `.jaff` file. |
| [`compare_reactions`](compare_reactions.md) | Log reactions present in one network but not the other. |
| [`compare_species`](compare_species.md) | Log species present in one network but not the other. |
| [`check_sink_sources`](check_sink_sources.md) | Report (and warn, or abort) species never produced or never consumed. |
| [`check_recombinations`](check_recombinations.md) | Report (and warn, or abort) cations lacking an electron recombination. |
| [`check_isomers`](check_isomers.md) | Report (and warn, or abort) species sharing the same atomic composition. |
| [`sfluxes`](sfluxes.md) | Return symbolic flux expressions for all reactions. |
| [`sodes`](sodes.md) | Return symbolic ODE right-hand sides for all species. |
| [`sradodes`](sradodes.md) | Return symbolic radiation moment ODE right-hand sides. |
| [`to_hdf5`](to_hdf5.md) | Write a pre-tabulated rate coefficient table to an HDF5 file. |
| [`to_txt`](to_txt.md) | Write a pre-tabulated rate coefficient table to a plain-text file. |
| [`write_table`](write_table.md) | Write a pre-tabulated rate coefficient table in the specified format. |
